<b>Sawtooth Circlet</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It damages nearby enemies when activating [[Faydown Cloak]] or [[Drifter's Cloak]].

== Usefulness ==
When [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] activates [[Faydown Cloak]] or [[Drifter's Cloak]], a blade will slash around her in a circular motion, dealing damage. The blade's slashes will follow Hornet as she moves. 

* Detrimental during platforming, as it can sometimes destroy objects before Hornet can bounce off them with her [[Needle]].
* Most useful when paired with the Faydown Cloak, as it can be quickly activated for extra damage. Crests with a Down-slash that move Hornet downwards, such as the Hunter or Witch crest, can override the upwards momentum of the Faydown Cloak, allowing the blades to strike grounded enemies.
** Since Down-slashing an enemy refreshes the Faydown Cloak's mid-air jump, Hornet is able repeatedly combo Down-slashes, double jumps, and Sawtooth Circlet hits for great damage. 
* Attacks that land with the Sawtooth Circlet do not accumulate Silk.

== How to Acquire ==
Purchased from [[Twelfth Architect]] in [[Underworks]] for {{R|230}} and {{C|1}}.
